finalText: Migration finished. All 11 remaining call sites across `support`, `orders`, `catalog`, `billing`, `analytics`, and `accounts` now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Only `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` still uses `db.query`, and I left it — it's a vendored file explicitly marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on upgrade." If that adapter needs to move too, it'll have to happen upstream or via a wrapper, not a direct edit.
